title: Surreal Teacup Dreamscape
description: A giant ornate pink teacup overflows with oranges and patterned fruits in the foreground. Inside the cup, two stylized female faces in yellow and purple sit back-to-back while a large black silhouette of a woman's profile looms in the swirling purple sky above. A rustic red barn stands in a misty field under a glowing sun with floating orbs and patterned trees.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape featuring a massive ornate pink teacup in the foreground overflowing with oranges and patterned citrus fruits. Two stylized women's faces sit inside the cup, one yellow and one purple, facing opposite directions. A large black silhouette of a woman's profile dominates the swirling purple cloudy sky. In the background stands a weathered red wooden barn in a misty green field, with glowing sun rays, floating orange orbs, and fruit-bearing trees under a vibrant sunset sky.
